title: Scoped native UAT journeys with separate deterministic evidence and pending independent review
user_story: A release reviewer can inspect each genuinely executed required exploratory journey and its independent application-state assertions.

requirements.description: Require separate raw identity and passing deterministic assertions per journey.
Package only individually passing current-source exact-head canonical UAT runs.
Restrict disposable writes to owned project/session or prepared native mission IDs.
Preserve original settings failure ledger, one-use exception scope and bounded execution.
Label controlled network faults and retain all unrelated browser errors.
Reuse actual mission/protocol CPU execution and preserve raw artifacts.
Keep UI technical-review payload compatible with strict backend ReviewNote.

nonfunctional: All four required journey IDs and independent review remain mandatory.
Use disposable PHDLAB_DATA_DIR and owned browser/model endpoint; no paid API fallback.
No model calls, grant consumption, global ledger updates, commits or full qualification in this implementation task.
Production coverage remains informational; complete mandatory regression is required before publication.
inputs: Owned synthetic setup and fixed application/model configuration
Canonical UAT reports and raw artifacts
outputs: Per-journey deterministic checks and retained raw browser/native evidence
Explicit BLOCKED/UNVERIFIED results for missing model/history/evidence
preconditions: Single dev writer and existing reviewed skills
Separate applicable authorization before any future model execution
postconditions: A settings bundle cannot stand for other journeys.
No deterministic selftest is promoted into live AI-UAT or scientific evidence.
Original settings three-failure ledger and sole unused allowance are unchanged.
dependencies: Existing Browser Use environment, Chromium and owned browser proxy
Existing mission/protocol/experiment runtime and strict API schemas
Existing source identity, evidence publisher and independent acceptance policy
acceptance_criteria: Behavioral RED/GREEN policy fixtures and targeted integration execute without model calls.
Actual AI-UAT for every required journey remains NOT_RUN until separately executed.
Independent acceptance/scientific review is never generated by the packager.

scenarios.expected: A settings action history cannot qualify three unexecuted journeys.
A false deterministic assertion cannot be overridden by AI success.
Raw journey identity matches its declaration.
Separately executed runs package per journey, retain review=PENDING, and reject stale heads, duplicate reports or mocked agent identity.
Project paths, providers, arbitrary prompts, tools and foreign sessions are denied.
Native workflow writes bind exact prepared IDs/digest and strict review body.
A fresh task key cannot bypass the exhausted original settings budget.
Standard and owner-specific step/deadline bounds remain enforced.
Only the exact injected fault is exempt; unrelated errors remain visible.
Actual native mission creates CPU artifacts and completes technical review without model calls; absent model history remains unqualified AI-UAT.
Owned browser observes one controlled config503 then actual reload/recovery.
Backend ReviewNote remains strict; the UI sends only note.

recovery: Preserve every failing run and budget; unrelated browser errors block acceptance. No alternate key, model or grant may bypass the settings ledger.
test_environment: Metadata/action fixtures are MOCKED. Real disposable HTTP/Chromium/native CPU integration proves only its stated assertions; no model inference, scientific endorsement or release qualification.

review.method: Implementation-agent threat/oracle review plus separate read-only agent source review. Live acceptance and scientific review remain pending.

tdd.scope: Actual RED3FAIL for existing evidence-validation false acceptance, followed by targeted GREEN37PASS. Wrapper mode REAL_LOCAL means local Python execution; metadata fixtures remain MOCKED. No AI-UAT run occurred.

limitations: Project/chat actual model response and Browser Use actions are NOT_RUN.
Controlled config-network recovery does not certify a real provider outage.
Harness interaction level L3 and synthetic CPU artifacts do not establish research autonomy or scientific validity.
Complete pr/all and remote current-head CI are delegated to the root after source freeze.
